d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how the United States military has issued a stark warning to Madagascar, urging the island nation not to allow Russia to replicate its 'Sahel model' in the Indian Ocean. US Africa Command (AFRICOM) Deputy Commander Lt. Gen. John Brennan warned that Moscow’s security partnerships—seen in Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger—fail to stop militant violence while eroding national sovereignty and exploiting natural resources.
